experiment: E53 pure-EEG lightweight robust open-set embedding

model.input: 1x18x1200 raw EEG; per-trial differentiable channelwise linear detrend, median centering and 1.4826*MAD scaling with RMS fallback
model.prototypes: trainable normalized identity prototypes initialized by initial-model fit-fold class means
model.arpl_definition: two-sided margin ranking on true-class and nearest-other cosine distance with trainable softplus class radii; no unknown class

training.allowed_compute_fallback: Active for the 30 comparable inner trainings on one 16 GB GPU: PGD3 waveform cache refreshed every 5 epochs against the current model; online PGD7 remains implemented for smoke benchmarking; formal evaluation always remains raw-waveform PGD20
training.target_rule: next identity in the sorted enrolled-class cycle; optimization after attack always uses the true identity
training.early_stopping_data: corresponding inner clean known/pseudo-unknown and lightweight attacks only; never outer or Test
training.selection_rule: maximize complete lightweight-proxy Score at clean known acceptance >=0.95, then direct C, clean AUROC, U@95, earlier epoch
training.full_train_capacity: fit all 20 identities for rounded median available inner best epochs; capacity check only

protocol.subset_rule: sort each eligible subject/task group by trial/path and take first 8 without outcome-based sampling
protocol.aggregation: threshold selected separately within each outer group by pooling its two inner runs; report pair and available-fold means
protocol.outer_rule: run only once if every full-inner gate passes; otherwise outer=N/A

attacks.radius: per-trial L2 norm after channelwise temporal demeaning divided by 10^(SNR/20)
attacks.pgd_step: 2*radius/steps with L2-normalized gradient and per-trial L2 projection
attacks.fgsm_step: one L2-normalized gradient step to radius
attacks.differentiable_chain: raw waveform -> per-trial detrend/MAD -> EEGNet -> L2 embedding -> normalized prototype cosine logits

threshold.constraint: pooled corresponding inner clean known acceptance >=0.95
threshold.objective: maximize macro Score=100*C^0.40*A^0.35*U^0.25 across all six attacks; ties by RA, ASafeR, C, U, configured score order
threshold.q05: retain clean-known fifth percentile for U@95

reporting.auc: larger confidence means known; unknown AUPR uses negated confidence
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only pseudo-unknown and continuous file-block proxy, not cross-session or official-new-subject evidence; Test=N/A
